Issue 4540 -- which pass turns the groupshared global into i1
generated by make-pass-attribution.py; every command below was executed as shown

##############################################################################
# 1. WHY THE OBVIOUS INSTRUMENT (-Oconfig) MEASURES NOTHING
##############################################################################

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main -fcgl repro.hlsl
  exit=0x00000000  groupshared global = i32   lowered DXIL present: False
$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main repro.hlsl
  exit=0x00000000  groupshared global = i1   lowered DXIL present: True
$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main -Oconfig=-opt-fn-passes,-opt-mod-passes repro.hlsl
  exit=0x00000000  groupshared global = i1   lowered DXIL present: True
  ^ an EMPTY pass list still produced fully lowered DXIL identical to the
    default, so -Oconfig is ignored on a DXIL compile and every
    -Oconfig measurement is void.

##############################################################################
# 2. dxopt: a pass runner whose null control differs from its test
##############################################################################

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main repro.hlsl -fcgl -Fo <triage>\issues\4540\scratch-passes\hl.bc
  exit=0x00000000   (front-end module, before any pass)
  input module groupshared global = i32   lowered DXIL present: False

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxopt.exe -o=<triage>\issues\4540\scratch-passes\CONTROL-no-passes.bc <triage>\issues\4540\scratch-passes\hl.bc -opt-mod-passes
  exit=0x00000000  groupshared global = i32
$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxopt.exe -o=<triage>\issues\4540\scratch-passes\globalopt-alone.bc <triage>\issues\4540\scratch-passes\hl.bc -opt-mod-passes -globalopt
  exit=0x00000000  groupshared global = i1

  null control -> i32 ; -globalopt -> i1
  The two differ, so this instrument can tell the two states apart --
  which is exactly what the -Oconfig 'control' in section 1 could not do.

##############################################################################
# 3. is -globalopt NECESSARY, or would another pass do it too?
##############################################################################

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T cs_6_0 -E main -Odump repro.hlsl
  116 passes in the default pipeline; '-globalopt' occurs 1 time(s)
$ dxopt -o=<full-pipeline.bc> <hl.bc> <116 passes: full-pipeline>
  exit=0x00000000  groupshared global = i1   lowered DXIL present: True
$ dxopt -o=<full-pipeline-minus-globalopt.bc> <hl.bc> <115 passes: full-pipeline-minus-globalopt>
  exit=0x00000000  groupshared global = i32   lowered DXIL present: True

==============================================================================
The load rewrite is the other half of the signature. In
control-static-readback.hlsl the two stored values are 0 and 2, and the
load comes back as `%9 = select i1 %8, i32 2, i32 0` -- the non-IsOneZero
arm of TryToShrinkGlobalToBoolean, which reconstructs the original value
at each use. So the shrink is value-preserving for a single thread; what
it does not preserve is a groupshared OBJECT of a type docs/DXIL.rst:240
defines for groupshared memory.
